en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town with many low houses, several factory chimneys, and a prominent church tower in the distance. In the foreground are trees and a park-like area. At the top, a red handwritten number '1583' appears. At the bottom, in red script, is a German caption identifying the town and viewpoint, and in small print at the lower left is the name of the publisher.
